info.title: OpenSprite Skills API
info.description: Strict local Skills management with automatic global inheritance and same-name workspace precedence. Workspace registrations shadow global Skills even when disabled or invalid. Mutations require catalog expectedRevision.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Required for workspace scope; global scope uses this to calculate same-name workspace precedence.

200.description: Archived or already missing directory; registration removed.

manifest.description: Strict JSON: scope, workspaceId (nullable), directoryName, expectedRevision. All fields required; unknown and duplicate fields rejected. Metadata maximum 1 MiB.

archive.description: ZIP maximum 12 MiB; stored or deflated, unencrypted. One root SKILL.md or one wrapper directory. Maximum 200 files, depth 8, total expanded 10 MiB, SKILL.md 64 KiB, other file 5 MiB. Paths and CRC validated before atomic publication. Imported Skills are enabled after successful validation.

path.description: Optional validated relative package path; never an absolute path.
